meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 ast-grep 按代码结构而不是文字来做搜索和改写，覆盖 25 种语言：能找出形如 X 的函数、调用、类或导入，做批量改写，也能跑 YAML 规则；模式本身必须是合法代码，不是正则。
howto.when: 当目标是语法形状时接管，比如「所有形如 X 的调用/类/导入」、批量改写（codemod）或 YAML 规则；如果找的是字符串内容、注释、文件名，原文建议改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按结构匹配，不是文本搜索

say.text: 扫一下 src/ 下的 YAML 规则，列出违规项

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages: it finds functions, calls, classes, or imports shaped like X, applies bulk rewrites, and runs YAML rules. Patterns must be valid code, not regex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a syntax pattern — every call, class, or import shaped like X, a codemod, or a YAML rule — rather than literal text. For strings, comments, or filenames, use rg instead.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) in this repo
Find every function that takes a Request parameter
Scan src/ with our YAML rules and list violations
say_en.note: Needs an sgconfig.yml in the project
